GUEST_ID_VIEW.reason: deliberately not a mapper: run() returns no result and the number must never enter state. Production uses guestid.ts / guestid-ui.tsx (GuestIdRevealButton calls RevealGuestId: PERM-GST-003, transient dialog, nothing stored)
RevealGuestId returns the number in the command result but the screen reads it from the guest record (guestRevealId); needs a shared hook — left to the guests area (W4-1)

BACKUP_SIMULATE.reason: demonstration only (audit-only simulated backup); real backups are run by the server deployment, not from the app

EDIT_BLOCK.reason: no EditRoomBlock command on the server (IRoomBlockEditPort is internal to group-block changes); the prototype has no edit-block screen

GRP_BLOCK_ALLOT.reason: no server command changes a block’s allotment (inventory backlog)

GRP_RELEASE.reason: ReleaseGroupBlock needs the block version, which no server read returns yet; partial release has no server command

GRP_BLOCK_CANCEL.reason: no server command cancels a group block

GRP_ROOMING.reason: rooming-list pickup = one CreateReservation per row with the block — reservations area (W4-1) / backlog

CORRECTION_ADJUST.reason: Server corrections (RequestAdjustment, action correction) reverse one whole posted charge line by id; the prototype posts a free-form signed amount for a closed date. Needs a charge picker (UI) and folio/charge ids from the money area (W4-3).

CORRECTION_ADJUST_DECIDE.reason: DecideApproval needs the approval id + version from the approvals slice, which the money area (W4-3) owns; map it there together with SHIFT_DIFFERENCE_DECIDE.

POST_NIGHTS.reason: M1 compatibility command with no UI button; CLOSE_RUN covers it.

GRANT.reason: role templates are the server seed (0101 + module seeds); no command edits them yet — role matrix v2 (D1–D7) decides

POLICY_SET.reason: no server command edits role templates or role limits yet (same as GRANT)

POLICY_DECIDE.reason: no policy change requests on the server (Tech admin PERM-ADM-002 R has nothing to request yet)

TARIFF_SCHEDULE.reason: dated tariffs are published by the Yield module (PublishYieldTariffs, W4-11); no plain schedule/withdraw command

TAX_SCHEDULE.reason: replaced by the dated GST master (DEC-069) — SETTING_SET on gst.* keys

SETTINGS.reason: legacy BL-027 command; no screen sends it — SETTING_SET per key instead

EXPENSE_APPROVE.reason: expenses area (W4-7) — shown on Approvals & audit

MSG_DOC_EXTRACT.reason: document capture (simulated OCR of fictional samples) belongs to the ID/document capture area (W4-11 / Documents module); no messaging server command

ID capture on the server needs the real image of a guest document (CaptureIdDocument: guestId + image); the prototype extracts from fictional samples — needs a capture screen (and messagingX.docs belongs to W4-10)

MSG_DOC_CONFIRM.reason: document capture: W4-11 (applies to guest profile / expense draft, other areas)
maps to ConfirmIdCapture once captures exist (captureId + expectedVersion); depends on MSG_DOC_EXTRACT and the docs slice owner

MSG_DOC_DISCARD.reason: maps to RejectIdCapture once captures exist; same dependency

HOV_CLOCK.reason: demo-only simulated clock; production uses the real property clock (the server has no such command by design)

CHN_WEB_REQUEST.reason: public website form preview: the real guest submission is the anonymous POST /public/booking/requests (rate-limited, no staff session); staff only confirm/decline

capabilityGaps: Accountant gets "expenses" (server PERM-EXP-001:A); the prototype Accountant has reports only.
Cashier gets "reports" through PERM-RPT-002:V (finance view) — same as the prototype; Accountant/Manager/Owner through PERM-RPT-001.

"approve" follows PERM-APR-001 only (Owner A, Manager L). Expense approval (PERM-EXP-002) and shift-difference approval (PERM-SHF-002) are re-checked by the server per command; Accountant does not get the prototype "approve" gate.
Request-only grants (mode R, e.g. Reception PERM-FOL-005 credit note, PERM-PAY-003 refund) show the button; the server answers APPROVAL_REQUIRED when an approval is needed.
Limits (mode L: Manager discount/rate BPS, approval amounts) are enforced by the server; the client shows the action and maps the refusal.

Module PERM ids without a coarse prototype permission (PERM-ACC/CMP/CRM/DOC/GRP/HR/INV/OTA/SOD/WEB, PERM-HOV-*, PERM-MNT-*, PERM-POS*) do not change can(); module screens keep their existing gates. The fine-grained s.policy (HccPolicy) is not derived from the server yet (W4-5).
